04 — Published Author

Books

Children's Literature · Rare Disease Advocacy

Max and Milo:
Life with XLH

by Rachael Jones, illustrated by Lydia Davis

Max is a boy who enjoys playing with his friends, camping with his family, and going on adventures with his dog, Milo. Max also happens to have XLH — a rare genetic disorder affecting approximately 1 in 20,000 people. Along the way, Max learns that he is special and rare, which is a good thing, and that XLH is a part of him — but not what defines him.

Written in collaboration with her children, and drawn from her own lived experience with XLH, Rachael created this book to help children and families feel encouraged, connected, and hopeful. A meaningful resource for families, teachers, and school counselors alike.
